items.title: Israel and Hezbollah agree ceasefire, US says, as more Lebanon strikes reported
items.description: The agreement followed concerns that continued clashes would undermine the deal to end the war between the US and Iran.

items.title: Italy's Meloni says Trump 'made up' story that she 'begged' him for photo at G7
items.description: The highly public exchange is an indication that their earlier close ties have frayed  since Trump's decision to go to war with Iran.

items.title: US to end funding of South Africa's HIV programmes over claims of Afrikaner persecution
items.description: The US says South Africa is not doing enough to protect the white-minority Afrikaner community.

items.title: Zelensky stripped of highest Polish honour over WW2 name of army unit
items.description: Ukraine has denounced the move, calling it a "strategic mistake" and "disrespectful".

items.title: Do it at home too, women tell Japanese fans who cleaned World Cup stadium
items.description: Some see a double standard: Japanese men who clean in public while their wives do all the housework.

items.title: Six-year-old Ebola patient taken from DR Congo hospital found and 'doing well'
items.description: Health facilities have come under attack during the current outbreak as a result of misinformation and fear.

items.title: Pétanque player, 68, dies after being 'hit in head with metal boule'
items.description: The man was allegedly struck by his 81-year-old opponent, who has since been arrested, the public prosecutor says.

items.title: Boy, 12, wins hearts after trying to check sick chicken into Ethiopian hospital
items.description: Markos's beloved hen was not responding to any treatments - so he did the only thing he could think of.

items.title: Morocco captain Achraf Hakimi to stand trial for rape
items.description: French prosecutors confirm Morocco captain Achraf Hakimi will stand trial for rape, in accusations dating back to 2023.

items.title: Zimbabwe MPs pass bill to extend president's time in power
items.description: The proposal would extend Emmerson Mnangagwa's term by two years and scrap direct presidential elections.

items.title: Mangione's lawyers reverse course on psychiatric defence in state murder trial
items.description: The defence team reverse course a day after saying they would argue he suffered "extreme emotional disturbance".

items.title: UK actress charged with importing meth worth almost A$300m into Australia
items.description: Emaa Hussen, 34, faces life in prison for allegedly trying to smuggle 320kg of meth hidden in bags of charcoal.
